puzzles.label: Logic Puzzle
puzzles.question: Three switches are outside a closed room. Inside are three incandescent bulbs. Each switch controls exactly one bulb. You may manipulate the switches however you like, but may enter the room only once. How can you determine which switch controls which bulb?
puzzles.answer: Turn switch 1 on for several minutes, then turn it off. Turn switch 2 on and enter the room. The bulb that is on belongs to switch 2. Of the two bulbs that are off, the warm bulb belongs to switch 1; the cold bulb belongs to switch 3.
